limits: the storage policy is enforced in the artifact writer, not in the object store itself: an operator who points SBOM_STORAGE_DIR at a node-local disk still has no backup until they set SBOM_STORAGE_BACKUP_DIR, and this code cannot check that the backup target is a different failure domain
